label: risky
summary: The selected historical release contains an installation hook launching a malicious bundled DLL, as documented in the incident sources.

findings.title: DEP-002: Malicious installation payload in eslint-config-prettier 10.1.7
findings.description: The PR adds eslint-config-prettier 10.1.7. Published incident evidence documents an install hook invoking node install.js and a Windows launcher invoking the bundled node-gyp.dll through rundll32.
findings.recommendation: Remove the compromised release and select a verified unaffected version. If it was installed, assess potential execution and credential exposure.

evidence.observation: Adds eslint-config-prettier 10.1.7. The version diff and launcher are preserved at https://github.com/prettier/eslint-config-prettier/issues/339. The install hook and added DLL are also documented at https://safedep.io/blog/eslint-config-prettier-major-npm-supply-chain-hack.

uncertainty: Historical incident evidence is used; the package was not installed or executed during fixture creation.
The application operating system and whether installation occurred are unknown.
This isolated fixture does not resolve or assess the eslint peer dependency.
